other_names: Glashallen (glass hall, built 2010 with the City Tunnel)
levels.note: No source gives a signposted level name ("Plan 0" etc.). Jernhusen's pages name the halls on this level: Glashallen, Entréhall (Espresso House Entréhall), Gröna Hallen (unstaffed toilets) and the Food Court (Tawana). Wikipedia: two perpendicular buildings (central hall, food court since 2011; terminus train shed) joined by the 2010 glass corridor, which is the main waiting area and holds ticket sales, exchange and kiosks.

levels.name: Malmö C Nedre
levels.note: "Malmö C Nedre (Lower)" is the name Wikipedia gives the City Tunnel station section under Malmö C; whether that or a "Plan -x" is what the signs say is not stated by any source read. Tracks 1–4 here are two island platforms (1–2 north, usually southbound; 3–4 south, usually northbound). OSM tags the lifts down to it as level -2, with an intermediate -1 at the Anna Lindhs plats (west) entrance; no source names a -1 level.
